chain.label: Korean Air's nonprecision-approach training was inadequate
chain.trigger: simulator syllabus never included a countdown/count-up DME approach like Guam's localizer-only procedure

chain.label: Rising terrain near the NIMITZ VOR along the approach path
chain.trigger: captain had earlier called the VOR area a 'black hole' requiring extra attention

chain.label: Captain gave an inadequate approach briefing
chain.trigger: captain briefed a 'short' visual approach and omitted the localizer approach's fix definitions and crossing altitudes

caused_by.evidence: captain's fatigue noted repeatedly on the CVR
training never required a detailed nonprecision-approach briefing

chain.label: Flight encountered IMC and rain on final approach
chain.trigger: Doppler radar showed heavy rain over rising terrain along the approach corridor near the outer marker

chain.label: Captain lost awareness of the airplane's position on the approach
chain.trigger: CVR recorded conflicting captain statements about whether the inoperative glideslope was 'working'

caused_by.evidence: inadequate briefing left the crew without fix definitions and crossing altitudes
loss of visual contact with the airport in rain obscured positional cues

chain.label: Captain prematurely commanded lower altitude-selector settings
chain.trigger: captain ordered 1,440 feet then 560 feet set before the airplane reached the associated step-down fixes

caused_by.evidence: premature orders to reset the altitude selector indicated he had lost awareness of the airplane's position

chain.label: Airplane descended below the required intermediate step-down altitudes
chain.trigger: flight 801 descended below 2,000 feet and 1,440 feet before reaching GUQQY and the VOR

caused_by.evidence: autopilot captured the prematurely selected altitudes and continued the descent

chain.label: First officer and flight engineer failed to monitor and challenge the premature descents
chain.trigger: CVR showed no crew discussion challenging the descents below 2,000 and 1,440 feet

caused_by.evidence: inadequate briefing left the first officer and flight engineer unprepared to monitor the approach
premature descents occurred without any recorded crew challenge

chain.label: FAA had intentionally inhibited Guam's MSAW low-altitude alert
chain.trigger: MSAW had been inhibited within a 54-nm ring since February 1995 to reduce nuisance warnings

chain.label: CERAP controller failed to monitor flight 801 after handoff to the tower
chain.trigger: controller did not observe the radar target or notice the descent below minimum safe altitude before the crash

caused_by.evidence: inhibited MSAW meant no low-altitude alert was generated for the controller to notice

chain.label: Captain failed to react to GPWS alerts and delayed the missed approach
chain.trigger: captain did not respond to the GPWS 'minimums' callout and began a go-around only after the first officer's second call, about 6 seconds before impact

caused_by.evidence: the uncorrected low descent produced the terrain-proximity GPWS alerts
lack of earlier challenge left the error uncorrected until GPWS alerts sounded

chain.label: Airplane struck rising terrain at Nimitz Hill
chain.trigger: airplane impacted hilly terrain about 660 feet msl, 3.3 nm from the runway threshold

caused_by.evidence: the missed approach was initiated too late to clear terrain
impact occurred on rising terrain along the approach path

chain.label: 228 fatalities and 26 serious injuries resulted from the crash and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: of 254 persons on board, 228 were killed and 23 passengers and 3 flight attendants survived with serious injuries

caused_by.evidence: airplane was destroyed by impact forces and a postcrash fire
